reverse_dcf_check: At $31.545 the committed equity is $15643M; with warrants worth ~$2987M (Black-Scholes, 75% vol) and $3,700M net cash, operating EV is ~$14930M. Less SkyWater ($820M) and other units ($1,620M), that leaves ~$12490M for computing. Compounded at 15% to 2035 plus ~$2.5B of interim burn, the 2035 computing franchise must be worth ~$48627M: NOPAT ~$2385M, or ~$12078M revenue at a 25% EBIT margin. That is ~21% of McKinsey's $57B 2035 midpoint, held with certainty. On base rates (Kalshi: useful QC by any firm before 2035 at 48%; IonQ a top-2 winner in perhaps 35-40% of those worlds) the success odds are ~0.2, so the success state would need more than 100% of the market. The market is therefore pricing either a TAM 4-5x McKinsey's, a much lower discount rate, or near-certain leadership. I take the gap as a value view: fundamental fair value ~$13.99, well below spot. Because quantum names have held large premiums for long periods, only part of that gap closes in my 12-month ladder (median ~$25.82). Company guidance covers only 2026 revenue ($450-460M), so it does not bridge the gap. The engine's EV/sales leg is a 5% sanity check, and the implied WACC it prints is not meaningful because FCFF is negative through FY2030.

sbc_treatment.note: FY2025 SBC $312.0M (F43); TTM $450.0M (F46). Every leg costs SBC as an expense: GAAP operating losses and burn are treated as cash-equivalent, and the share count is held at the committed 495.9M (shares now + Oct-2026 offering + Elisity) with no extra SBC dilution. Pre-funded warrants are counted as shares and option-like warrants are deducted at Black-Scholes value. Peer sales multiples are basis-neutral to SBC.

reasoning: Base rates first. IONQ's own history (monthly closes 2021-26): annualized vol ~97%, max drawdown -86% (2021-22), and over 58 overlapping 12-month windows a median return of +35%, but 17% of windows lost more than 50% and 34% more than doubled. That sample is dominated by the 2023-25 quantum rally. Event base rates: the stock fell after each of the last Heights-style raises (Oct-2025 deal at $93 was followed by a $49 November close). Field-level success odds come from prediction markets: Kalshi prices a useful quantum computer before 2030 at 33%, before 2035 at 48% and before 2040 at ~60%; Manifold Q-Day before 2030 is 17.6%. On long-run valuation ranges, IONQ trades at ~21x forward sales, its cheapest in five years against a 132x five-year average (Yahoo/consensus), so de-rating has already happened, but from extreme levels. IonQ's own roadmap record is mixed: self-defined #AQ milestones were hit early, but the 2020 promise of broad quantum advantage by 2025 was missed. Valuation: after the Oct-14 $2B raise and the Elisity deal the committed share count is 495.9M plus 179.6M warrants; net cash is ~$3.7B today and ~$2.6B at the horizon after ~$1.1B of GAAP-basis burn. Five creative legs (rNPV tree, TAM states, cash floor + option, transaction marks vs Quantinuum, SOTP) plus a small EV/sales check give a fundamental fair value of ~$13.99. The reverse DCF shows the market needs ~21% of the 2035 quantum computing market with certainty. Ladder: a fundamental pull alone would put the median near $14, but quantum premiums persist (QNT, RGTI and QBTS trade at 150-330x sales). So the ladder is a scenario mixture (bear $15 p0.35, base $28 p0.45, bull $62 p0.20, within-scenario vol 38-45%), giving a median ~$25.82 and a mean ~$32.79, with ~38% chance of finishing above today's $31.545. Research limits: X/Twitter not used; McKinsey's own page returned 503, so a dated summary was used; Twelve Data estimates and statistics endpoints need a higher plan and were skipped. Defense/intelligence revenue: management says ~60% of revenue is commercial (non-U.S.-government) in FY2025, Q1 and Q2 2026, so ~40% comes from U.S. government customers (DoD bodies such as AFRL, DARPA, SDA and MDA, plus other agencies). The defense/intelligence subset is not disclosed and SkyWater's DoD trusted-foundry work may raise it.

bear.story: Roadmap slips (Superion 256 late), DARPA Stage C funding not appropriated, more stock-funded deals; computing option marked down.

base.story: Fundamental set as built: rNPV/TAM/option/transaction legs; computing worth ~$1.6B expected on top of $5.0B of cash and operating units.

bull.story: 256-qubit system delivered on time with logical-qubit demonstrations; field success odds re-rate up.

model_inputs.structure_note: The standard DCF/multiple structure cannot describe IonQ: FCFF is negative through the 5-year window and value rests on whether the computing roadmap succeeds, so the DCF leg carries weight 0 and value sits in custom legs (rNPV, TAM states, cash floor + option, transaction marks, SOTP) with a 0.05-weight EV/sales sanity leg. Warrants (179.6M at $69.46-$155) are an equity-level adjustment.
model_inputs.gap_note: fair_value.value (13.99) equals the engine base horizon value. The engine median (~13.4) is a fundamental distribution; my 12-month ladder (median ~25.8) is intentionally higher because base rates show quantum-theme premiums (QNT, RGTI, QBTS at 150-330x sales) persist well beyond a year, so only about a third of the gap to fundamental value is assumed to close by 2027-10-14 (bear $15 / base $28 / bull $62).
